items.statement: The submitted investigation supports favorable proton insertion at H0.25VO2(B) and identifies the less-coordinated O1(2TM) environment as the leading binding environment within the stated model and search scope.

items.statement: The conclusion is bounded by the finite candidate search, periodic-cell model and method dependence; it does not claim universal thermodynamic uniqueness.
